cases.name: Lisha Ann “Lee” Branum
cases.about: On her obituary tribute wall, her mom (no name) wrote, "Lisha was a very talented person. She was a quilter, sewed clothes, could cook anything ,a very good baker. She had a "green thumb" was very good at growing flowers , she believed that music helped the flowers grow. She truly lived for 2 people in this world. They were the love of her life. Anyone one that truly knew her , knew who that was..She should have been allowed to live her life longer. She was never a wealthy person but she just barely made it day by day. She enjoyed her country life. She was an Artist of different mediums. She didn't believe that she could paint . But she most certainly did. She was good at what ever she set out to do. I called her often on how to do something . We would shop , go out to eat, sometimes to just hang out together. I loved her more than words could tell for you see I'm her Mother. And believe me her life ended too soon."
cases.narrative: She died of gunshot wounds to the back, and had been deceased for a couple of days when she was found.
